status: posthoc diagnostic preregistered before this additional computation; motivated by failed external healthy cases
hypothesis: Dominant periodicity differences may contribute to failed external healthy acceptance; dominant peak is not verified shaft rotation frequency.
f0_selection: Per recording only: select largest power peak within fixed inclusive 10..100 Hz. Contact power is median across XYZ axes then median across windows; radar uses median across windows of reconstructed frame power. No labels or external healthy outcomes used to select peaks.
interpolation: Interpolate log10 power at relative_frequency*f0 only inside original measured 5..800 Hz support. Mark outside bins missing, never extrapolate. Center each window over observed relative-frequency bins.
missing_data: Retain validity mask in feature export. Classifier uses training-only recording-weighted per-column means and variances; unavailable values map to standardized zero. Columns entirely absent in training are ignored. Masks are not additional classifier features.
splits: Two fixed whole-recording baud-group directions 115200->460800 and reverse; plus all eight known recordings fit for external-only predictions. Corresponding contact/radar are kept in the same fold.
external_policy: keep and bigNormal excluded from all fitting, scaling, model selection and threshold calibration. Report every model and both external records per state, including failures.
offline_preprocessing: f0 uses all unlabeled windows within that individual recording, including held-out recordings; this is recording-level offline self-normalization, not online first-window inference.
geometry: Retained outer and keep ROI around 0.884 m conflicts with forty-something-cm physical target; normalization cannot repair selected scatterer.
reporting: File mean probability before macro-F1; healthy acceptance for bigNormal only. No unknown-fault rejection accuracy without threshold calibration. No bandwidth/model selection based on these external labels. No claim of independent external generalization from this posthoc analysis.
